answers.core: There's no way to access private members of a class in gdscript
answers.workaround:
```gdscript
var new_tooltip:String = ""
if <TreeItem>.get_button_count(<int column>) > 0:
   <TreeItem>.erase_button(<int column>, <int button_index>)

add_button(<int column>, null, <int button_index>, false, new_tooltip)
```
